guidance: As vendor registrations and approvals continue to progress, we expect meaningful revenue ramp-up from Q3 FY27 onwards.

risks: The statements made in today's call are not a guarantee of a future performance and also involve unforeseen risks and uncertainties.

focus: MMP was established in 1983 in Nagpur and over the last four decades, the company has evolved from an aluminum powder manufacturer into a diversified specialty materials and power infrastructure business.

Over the years, our strategy has remained focused on building businesses closely aligned with our core strengths in metallurgy, manufacturing, aluminum processing and long-standing customer relationships.
Supported by better execution, improved product mix, sustained export traction and continued focus on operational efficiency.
